verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly publish official SDKs or APIs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions any SDK, client library, or developer program. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, no llms.txt, a filing host that reset the connection, and a Business Express portal that disallows all crawling. Interaction is documented only through web forms, mail, phone, and PDF receipts.
